title: Scalar comparison of an external product-cover cocycle

from.place: Proof of Tag 0BF3: use the Kunneth cup map on the special fibre; identify the front/back Cech tensor cocycle with its cohomology external cup.

statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $F,G$ quasi-coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $U=(U_i)_{i\in I}$ and $V=(V_j)_{j\in J}$ be open covers. Set $W_{ij}=p_X^{-1}U_i\cap p_Y^{-1}V_j$ on $P=X\times_kY$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and $E=p_X^*F\otimes p_Y^*G$ [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. Let $A,B,C$ be the scalar Cech complexes of $(f,U,F)$, $(g,V,G)$ and $(p_X f,W,E)$ [def-sc-picard-external-right-cech-models]. Fix $p,q\in\mathbb N$ and scalar comparisons $e_X:H^p(A)\to H_k^p(X,F)$, $e_Y:H^q(B)\to H_k^q(Y,G)$, $e_P:H^{p+q}(C)\to H_k^{p+q}(P,E)$ satisfying IsPicardScalarCechComparison [lem-sc-picard-scalar-cech-comparison]. For cycles $a\in Z^p(A)$, $b\in Z^q(B)$, $z\in Z^{p+q}(C)$, assume every tuple coordinate of $z$ is the tensor of the front section of $a$ and the back section of $b$, pulled to $P$ by the tensor-pullback adjunction units [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] and restricted to the common product intersection; front and back are the Alexander--Whitney faces [def-sc-cech-cup-product]. Then $e_P([z])=\operatorname{externalCup}(f,g,F,G,p,q,e_X([a]),e_Y([b]))$. No cochain map from a tensor total, comparison-isomorphism hypothesis or affine-intersection hypothesis is assumed.

proof.text: Use the three IsPicardScalarCechComparison witnesses to pass through the explicit additive Cech homology identifications to the module comparisons. The cover equalities imply that the product-intersection family covers the fibre product. Its alpha resolution augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism, which makes each comparison canonical.

Refine the two factor covers along the projections to the product cover, with index maps (i,j) -> i and (i,j) -> j. Their unit-and-restriction formulas identify the stated coordinates with the Cech cup cochain of the refined cocycles. Apply the refinement comparison square and the Cech/sheaf cup comparison to identify the target class with the module cup of the two pulled-back classes.

Apply scalarExternalCup_moduleComparison to the ordinary module cup characterized by IsModuleCupProduct and the two compared factor classes. The refinement comparison squares from step 2 give its two module pullback arguments. Its equality therefore identifies the target class with externalCup. This reuses the existing scalar/module bridge rather than reconstructing it from Ext representatives.

lean.statement:
theorem picardScalar_externalCocycle_comparison
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    {ι κ : Type w} (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens)
    (hUc : iSup U = ⊤) (hVc : iSup V = ⊤) (p q : ℕ)
    (eX : ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).homology p →ₗ[k] scalarCohomology f F p)
    (heX : IsPicardScalarCechComparison f U F p eX)
    (eY : ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).homology q →ₗ[k] scalarCohomology g G q)
    (heY : IsPicardScalarCechComparison g V G q eY)
    (eP : ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj
            (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).homology (p + q) →ₗ[k]
        scalarCohomology (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) (p + q))
    (heP : IsPicardScalarCechComparison (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
      (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
        pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) (p + q) eP) :
    let A := (picardCechFunctor f U).obj F
    let B := (picardCechFunctor g V).obj G
    let P := (picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
      (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
        pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)
    ∀ (a : A.cycles p) (b : B.cycles q) (z : P.cycles (p + q)),
      (∀ y : Fin (p + q + 1) → ι × κ,
        TopCat.Presheaf.cechComplexFunctorXAddEquiv
          (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
            pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)
          (scalarPresheaf (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G))
          (p + q) (P.iCycles (p + q) z) y =
          tmulSection
            (((fun (Q : X.Opens) (W : (Limits.pullback f g).Opens)
                (h : W ≤ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ Q) (s : Γ(F, Q)) ↦
              ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
                (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
                  (pullback.fst f g))).unit.app F).val.app (op Q) s))
              (⨅ l, U (y (cupFront p q l)).1) _
              (by
                intro x hx
                change (pullback.fst f g).base x ∈ ⨅ l, U (y (cupFront p q l)).1
                rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_iInf, Set.mem_iInter]
                intro l
                exact (iInf_le (fun j ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U (y j).1 ⊓
                  pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V (y j).2) (cupFront p q l) hx).1)
              (TopCat.Presheaf.cechComplexFunctorXAddEquiv U (scalarPresheaf f F) p (A.iCycles p a)
                (fun l ↦ (y (cupFront p q l)).1))))
            (((fun (Q : Y.Opens) (W : (Limits.pullback f g).Opens)
                (h : W ≤ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ Q) (s : Γ(G, Q)) ↦
              ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
                (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
                  (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app G).val.app (op Q) s))
              (⨅ l, V (y (cupBack p q l)).2) _
              (by
                intro x hx
                change (pullback.snd f g).base x ∈ ⨅ l, V (y (cupBack p q l)).2
                rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_iInf, Set.mem_iInter]
                intro l
                exact (iInf_le (fun j ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U (y j).1 ⊓
                  pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V (y j).2) (cupBack p q l) hx).2)
              (TopCat.Presheaf.cechComplexFunctorXAddEquiv V (scalarPresheaf g G) q (B.iCycles q b)
                (fun l ↦ (y (cupBack p q l)).2))))) →
      eP (P.homologyπ (p + q) z) =
        externalCup f g F G p q (eX (A.homologyπ p a)) (eY (B.homologyπ q b))
